Uncle Rad

Biography

Uncle Rad sells sweets while secretly gathering information for the baron. Stark supplies the password that lets Kir and Kel approach him as allies. His advice includes the whereabouts of cyclopes and dragons who might help against Firez. Behind his discreet service lies a modest wish for a home, a family and ordinary happiness. [1, 2, 3]
